summary: 8 film announcements, 11 TV announcements across 5 trades.

film.title: Touch Grass
film.talent: Dave Clark (director), Brad Miska and Chris White (producers)
film.announcement: Promise AI is developing a horror feature with Dave Clark directing and Brad Miska and Backrooms EP Chris White producing.

film.title: Nice Eggs
film.talent: Jane Krakowski, Angourie Rice (stars), Amanda Lipitz (director)
film.announcement: Jane Krakowski and Angourie Rice star in coming-of-age drama Nice Eggs directed by Amanda Lipitz.

film.title: Merry Christmas Aubrey Flint
film.announcement: Samuel Goldwyn acquires North America rights to WestEnd Films' holiday comedy from distributor.

film.title: Ink
film.talent: Danny Boyle (director), Guy Pearce (as Rupert Murdoch)
film.announcement: Netflix sets U.S. release date for Danny Boyle's tabloid drama Ink and unveils first look at Guy Pearce as Rupert Murdoch.

film.title: Half
film.announcement: Best Friend Forever boards Malayalam-language Indian vampire thriller Half for TIFF Midnight Madness.

film.title: Head to Head
film.announcement: DreamLab Films boards satirical Iranian TIFF title Head to Head in which male cast forced to coverup.

film.title: Scam 2010
film.announcement: Sony LIV confirms Scam 2010 production will go ahead despite legal threat from Subrata Roy.

film.title: Paper Tiger
film.talent: James Gray (director), Adam Driver, Miles Teller, Scarlett Johansson (cast)
film.announcement: First trailer released for James Gray's tragic New York thriller Paper Tiger featuring Adam Driver, Miles Teller and Scarlett Johansson.

tv.title: The Sticks
tv.talent: Michelle Monaghan, Scott Bakula, Logan Marshall-Green (cast)
tv.announcement: Cast confirmed and first look released for Netflix YA hockey drama The Sticks starring Michelle Monaghan.

tv.title: Fauda
tv.announcement: Season 5 launch date on Netflix revealed with first-look images.

tv.title: Doomsweepers
tv.talent: Sarah Harper (director), Flying Bark, Lightfold (production companies)
tv.announcement: Animated horror-comedy series Doomsweepers in works from Monkie Kid director Sarah Harper, Flying Bark and Lightfold.

tv.title: Sorry, I Didn't Know
tv.announcement: Historic ITV run extends to seventh season.

tv.title: Dig
tv.talent: Amy Poehler, Hugh Laurie (cast), Mike Schur and J.J. Philbin (creators)
tv.announcement: Peacock drops first look at Hugh Laurie and Amy Poehler in Dig from Mike Schur and J.J. Philbin; November premiere date set.

tv.title: Payday
tv.announcement: Curtis '50 Cent' Jackson boards Payday TV series as executive producer via G-Unit Film & TV.

tv.title: Clueless
tv.announcement: Clueless sequel series awarded California tax credits.

tv.title: The Rockford Files
tv.announcement: The Rockford Files reboot awarded California tax credits.

tv.title: Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden
tv.announcement: HIDIVE and Mainichi Broadcasting System ink anime output deal with Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden premiere set.

tv.title: Jonas Brothers Podcast
tv.announcement: Jonas Brothers podcast and five other iHeartMedia shows coming to Disney+ and Hulu via licensing deal.

tv.title: Public Eye
tv.announcement: Peacock launches first serialized mobile game Public Eye with AI-generated content from Wolf Games.
